gw-deep-green.displayName: Deep Green (Green World act only — the One Filament Rule's single scoped exception)

display.purpose: The hero wordmark only. Cinzel full caps at clamp(2.75rem, 11vw, 9rem), leading 0.92 so the lines lock together as a mass. Split into an ivory block over a gold block, revealed per-letter by GSAP.

headline.purpose: Act titles such as the About heading. Display family at sentence-scale leading.

body.purpose: Supporting paragraphs and the hero subtitle. Jost Light, generously leaded, deliberately quiet under the serif.

label.purpose: The .text-caps utility. Gold eyebrows above headings, CTA text at 0.2em tracking, and scroll cues at 0.625rem / 0.3em tracking.

veils.name: hero-veil
veils.purpose: Opens at the middle so her face stays lit; closes hard at the bottom edge to hand off to the next act.

veils.name: titans-veil
veils.purpose: Fully transparent through the upper third; all suppression lives in the lower third where the type sits.

veils.name: reel-edge-veil
veils.purpose: Phone reel only. A weight at the foot of the frame: the photograph is completely unveiled through its top 54%, suppression begins only where the lockup lands, deepening to 0.32 at the hand-off edge. The wide reel carries NO veil - no type crosses the photograph there, so none is owed.

motion.name: power3.out
motion.purpose: Default entrance. Heavy deceleration into rest; the dominant curve in the cinematic layer.

motion.name: power3.inOut
motion.purpose: Symmetric reveals such as the Green World curtains parting from the centreline.

motion.name: power2.out
motion.purpose: Smaller lifts and secondary element entrances.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: Scroll-scrubbed parallax. Travel must map linearly to scroll position or the pin feels rubbery.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: The cinematic duration band. Stagger between siblings is 0.12s.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: The only CTA hover treatment. No fill change, no scale, no glow.

motion.name: BANNED-bounce
motion.purpose: Prohibited everywhere (control point exceeds 1, banned by the Dead-Stop Rule). The legacy --transition-bounce token was deleted in PIPELINE.2; the ban is retained as law.

components.name: Ghost CTA
components.description: The only button on a cinematic surface. The gold outline is the emphasis; there is no filled variant.
components.html: VER SU TRABAJO
components.css: .ds-cta-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #f4ecdb; border: 1px solid #C9A55C; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; font-family: Jost, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-cta-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-cta-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #C9A55C; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Eyebrow
components.description: The .text-caps label in gold that precedes an act heading.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { color: #C9A55C; font-family: Jost, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 2rem 0; }

components.name: About Panel
components.description: The nearest thing to a card in the system: a 3:4 framed media container with a gold inset OUTLINE (never a border, which would change the measured box and break framing parity). No background of its own, no shadow, no radius.
components.css: .ds-about-panel { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; outline: 1px solid rgba(201, 165, 92, 0.4); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-about-panel-media { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2b2620, #0b0a08); }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: In-act navigation. A tracked label above a 40px vertical gold rule that fades to transparent and pulses on a 2s loop. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-scrollcue { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: rgba(240, 233, 218, 0.6); font-family: Jost, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-scrollcue-line { display: block; width: 1px; height: 40px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(201,165,92,0.8), transparent); animation: ds-scrollcue-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-scrollcue-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(0); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(4px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scrollcue-line { animation: none; } }

components.name: Act (full-bleed stage)
components.description: The recurring unit of the system: a viewport-true stage holding one photograph at near-full brightness, a directional veil, a gold eyebrow, a display heading in warm ivory, and at most one ghost CTA. Acts advance; they do not stack.
components.html:
ACTO I

CRISTYNA
components.css: .ds-act { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 320px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0a08; padding: 6rem 1.5rem 4rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; } .ds-act-media { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(140deg, #6b6154, #26221d 60%, #0b0a08); } .ds-act-veil { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,10,8,0.72) 0%, rgba(11,10,8,0.42) 38%, rgba(11,10,8,0.60) 72%, rgba(11,10,8,0.92) 100%); } .ds-act-body { position: relative; } .ds-act-eyebrow { color: #C9A55C; font-family: Jost, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 1rem 0; } .ds-act-title { color: #f4ecdb; font-family: Cinzel, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 11vw, 9rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The photograph is the light source. The ground is not a backdrop the image sits on - it is what the image burns through. Every cinematic surface is a warm near-black room (#0b0a08) into which a single photograph of her is admitted at near-full brightness, and the veil laid over it is the thinnest film that still lets type survive. A veil is not a lid. The moment the veil is doing the work instead of the photograph, the world has failed.

One filament of metallic gold (#C9A55C) lights the room. It is a hairline, an eyebrow, a letterform, a rule - never a fill, never a glow orb, never a gradient wash. Its scarcity is what makes it read as gold rather than as yellow. Type carries its own luminosity rather than borrowing a plate to sit on: warm ivory (#f4ecdb) against the dark, glowing slightly, unboxed.

The format is theatrical. Surfaces advance as acts - full-bleed, viewport-true stages that occupy the whole screen and hand off to the next. Nothing is a card in a scroll; everything is a frame in a reel. Motion is heavy and decelerating (power3.out), never springy, never bouncing: real mass coming to rest. The interface recedes so the artifact leads.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground; never pure #000, never a cool OLED black
A single gold filament, used as line and letter rather than as surface
Serif display in full caps, tight leading, at genuinely architectural scale
Photography at near-full brightness under a 0.15-0.35 veil
Full-bleed viewport-true acts, not a card scroll
Square corners on cinematic surfaces; no pills, no bezels, no glass
Decelerating GSAP motion; scrubbed parallax is linear, never eased
Spanish and English at exact parity on every surface

rules.name: The One Filament Rule (amended PIPELINE.2)
rules.body: Exactly one accent lights the room. Gold appears as line, letter, or rule - never as a filled surface, never as a second accent alongside it, and never blended into another hue. One exception is ratified, and it is scoped: the Green World act sets its type accent in Deep Green (#0B5D2A), because that act flips polarity to dark ink on bright water and gold cannot survive there at any weight. The exception belongs to that single act; the venture reds stay behind their own gate.

rules.name: The Dwell Law
rules.body: A story act pins for +=120%; a showcase pins for +=300%; the footer never pins. A new act chooses one of the two prices - a third duration is a design-system change, not a tuning.

rules.name: The Owned Ground Rule (BOOK.ACT.2)
rules.body: An act that holds the frame must cover the frame: a pinned act's ground reaches the bottom edge at its settled position and at every point of the hold, so no strip of the next act shows beneath it. A held act is therefore a full-viewport stage on .cine-act-vh, with min-height and never height. The svh-on-pinned rule protects a scrubbed stage's playhead, which would jump if the stage re-measured mid-scrub; a held act has no playhead, so a story act's dwell takes dvh and only the scrub showcases stay on svh.

rules.name: The Publisher Law
rules.body: The book act is a coming-soon teaser only: no title, no date, no cover, no way to buy. Every string is the /book page's own bilingual copy via the same locale keys - a census, not new claims.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Rule
rules.body: The ground is #0b0a08 and its veils are rgba(11,10,8,a). Pure #000 and cool blue-blacks are both regressions: the warmth is what lets her skin tones sit in the frame without going waxy.

rules.name: The Two Systems Rule
rules.body: The cinematic palette is normative for everything a visitor sees. /admin and the shadcn internals are explicitly exempt and may keep the legacy :root tokens. Any appearance of #121212 or #C4A86C on a public surface is drift, not a choice.

rules.name: The Unboxed Type Rule
rules.body: Type earns legibility from its own weight, color, and the veil beneath it - never from a plate, chip, or panel drawn behind it. If text needs a box to be readable, the veil is wrong, not the type.

rules.name: The Parity Rule
rules.body: Every string ships in Spanish and English. ES and EN locale files are held at exact key parity (625 / 625 today). Spanish is primary; English is parity, not a follow-up.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Rule
rules.body: Cinematic acts are edge-to-edge and viewport-true. A max-width container, a visible gutter, or a card boundary on an act is a regression - the frame is the viewport.

rules.name: The Atmosphere-Not-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth is made of light and distance, never of a drop shadow. Nothing on a cinematic surface floats above the ground plane.

rules.name: The Hard-Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius on a cinematic surface is zero. Pills, squircles, rounded-[2rem] shells, and nested bezels are all foreign bodies here.

rules.name: The Dead-Stop Rule
rules.body: Motion decelerates into place and stops. Nothing overshoots, springs back, or bounces. If a curve's control points exceed 1, it does not belong on a cinematic surface.

dos: Do paint #0b0a08 behind every media container, so a sub-cover scale reveals brand-dark edges instead of transparency.
Do route every hero-media surface through resolveHeroMediaStyle. Test: an editor preview and the published page must produce identical data-hero-framing strings.
Do use outline with a negative outline-offset for hairlines on framed media, never border - a border changes the measured box and breaks framing parity.
Do keep dvh on acts that just stand there - unpinned, or pinned and merely held - and svh on pinned SCRUB stages. Test: collapse the mobile URL bar mid-scrub; a scrubbed stage must not jump.
Do let the veil be directional - open where the photograph carries the frame, heavier only where type actually lands.
Do ship every string in ES and EN at the same time. Test: locale key counts stay equal.
Do decelerate into rest with power3.out, and use ease: 'none' for scroll-scrubbed travel so motion tracks the scrollbar exactly.
Do keep gold to lines, letters, and rules. Test: if you can point at a gold area, reduce it.
donts: No remote placeholder images of any kind (picsum.photos explicitly banned)
No copy rewrites: names, numbers, venture claims, and titles are owner-provided
No cream/light ground, no purple/emerald glow orbs, no glassmorphism bezels or nested hardware chrome on cinematic surfaces
No font swaps outside an explicit brick
No flat heavy scrims (the 50-80% murk) over reel photography
Variance/dice-roll behavior banned outside designated bake-off generation prompts
